faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Amethi District Part Time Yoga Instructor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Amethi District Part Time Yoga Instructor recruitment is 20 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Part Time Yoga Instructor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 15 vacancies available for the Part Time Yoga Instructor post in Amethi District.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The required qualifications include BNYS degree, BA/BSc Yoga with experience, MSc/MA Yoga, PG Diploma with experience, or Yoga Wellness Instructor certificate with experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Part Time Yoga Instructor position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Part Time Yoga Instructor position is between 21 years and 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Part Time Yoga Instructor role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 5000 to Rs. 8000 per month, with Rs. 8000 for males and Rs. 5000 for females.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Part Time Yoga Instructor recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Document Verification followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.answer: The official website for Amethi District is https://amethi.nic.in.
